name: keysmith
description: Optional official mod backend for Keysmith instruction deployment. Runtime mode replaces the system prompt; context mode adds project rules. Requires Claude Code 2.1.287+.

mode.title: Injection mode
mode.description: runtime replaces the default system prompt with rules followed by append text. context preserves the system prompt and adds rules to the first-message context.

rulesFile.title: Rules file
rulesFile.description: Absolute path to custom Markdown rules. Empty uses the plugin's examples/claude-project-rules.md.

appendFile.title: Append file
appendFile.description: Absolute path to append text. Empty uses examples/claude-append-prompt.md. A custom empty file disables append text. Used by runtime mode and the optional Keysmith agent.

registerAgent.title: Register Keysmith agent
registerAgent.description: Offer keysmith:keysmith with these same rules and append text. Does not change other custom or built-in agents.
